settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content: Free UK standard shipping on orders over £50 (£3.99 under). Express and next-day options at checkout. 30-day easy returns — see our Returns page for full details.

settings.heading: Crash replacement
settings.content: Trashed your kit in a crash? We'll replace it at 40% off within a year of purchase. Submit a claim with a photo and your order number.

settings.heading: Care
settings.content: Machine wash cold (30°C), no fabric softener, hang dry. Mud washes out — that's the point.
